headline: Unbeaten trio have conceded four goals apiece
dek: Frostburg State, West Liberty and Davis & Elkins are the three sides yet to lose, and each has let in exactly four goals. The other seven programmes have seventeen defeats between them, and West Virginia Wesleyan account for five of those on their own.
displaced_by: dek figures outgrown by the 12 Sep results: the other seven now have seventeen defeats and West Virginia Wesleyan five of them; headline still true and kept

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston's fourteen goals have come from nine different scorers, and no one of them has more than three; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Every programme has now conceded, and only West Virginia Wesleyan are still without a win.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Charleston have won four of their five matches and scored fourteen goals; their one defeat came at home to a visitor from outside the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anthony Fusay has two shutouts for Point Park, and no other keeper on the list has any.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan have lost all five of their matches, three of them to conference opponents, and have scored three goals while conceding thirteen.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Shawnee State have scored eleven goals and conceded thirteen; six of the eleven came in a single match.

findings.label: signal
findings.text: Leyton Collier's fourteen shots have produced three goals for West Liberty; no other player on the leaders list has taken more than ten.

last_match.line: Davis & Elkins are still unbeaten; Point Park have followed two straight wins with consecutive defeats.

next_match.line: West Liberty have won every match they have played; Wheeling have lost both of their conference matches so far.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
